stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: She used an analogy between roots and water pipes.
items.sentenceZh: 她把根系与水管作了类比。
items.scene: Two adjacent matching cross-sections: tree roots carry water up into trunk on left, branching water pipes carry water into a house on right. Identical blue flow arrows emphasize shared function while roots and pipes stay visibly different. No words.
items.altText: 树根与水管并排呈现，蓝色箭头展示类似的输水功能。

items.sentenceEn: Farmers sold fresh vegetables in the marketplace.
items.sentenceZh: 农民在市场里出售新鲜蔬菜。
items.scene: Contemporary Chinese outdoor produce marketplace with varied vegetable stalls, farmers exchanging fresh produce with shoppers, lively pedestrian setting, fully illustrated complete faces, no stall signs or logos.
items.altText: 中国露天市场里，农民向顾客出售新鲜蔬菜。

items.sentenceEn: The anchor held the boat in place.
items.sentenceZh: 锚使船停留在原处。
items.scene: Single clear cutaway coastal scene: small boat floats above an iron anchor firmly resting on seabed, connected by a continuous slack chain. Anchor recognizable curved flukes; gentle current passes boat, no person or words.
items.altText: 船通过完整的锚链连接海底铁锚，停在水面。

items.sentenceEn: She openly shared her ideas at the meeting.
items.sentenceZh: 她在会议上公开分享了自己的想法。
items.scene: Chinese neighborhood planning meeting: woman confidently speaks to an attentive open circle of adults, presenting a simple pictorial garden plan to everyone. Clear public sharing, no whispering, secret or readable writing.
items.altText: 社区会议上，女子面向众人公开分享花园规划想法。

items.sentenceEn: The artist created an animation of a running fox.
items.sentenceZh: 艺术家制作了一段狐狸奔跑的动画。
items.scene: Animation workstation with a monitor showing a clearly drawn orange running fox, alongside a filmstrip-like row of the SAME fox in successive poses, blank interface and no text. Focus on animated drawings, not a live fox.
items.altText: 绘制狐狸跑步的连续姿势，屏幕呈现动画中的狐狸。

items.sentenceEn: Giving one child all the crayons was unfair.
items.sentenceZh: 把所有蜡笔都给一个孩子是不公平的。
items.scene: Two children at the same drawing table, both with blank paper: adult places the entire shared crayon box in front of one child while the other receives none and looks disappointed. No accusation or caricature, clear unequal treatment.
items.altText: 同桌两个孩子都有画纸，却只有一个得到全部蜡笔。

items.sentenceEn: Repeated interruptions can annoy a reader.
items.sentenceZh: 反复打断会让读者烦恼。
items.scene: Three-panel micro-story: adult quietly reading, another adult repeatedly taps their shoulder to interrupt, reader begins to frown and raises a gentle stop hand. Repeated action causes irritation, no aggression or words.
items.altText: 读书的人被反复拍肩打断，逐渐皱眉并示意暂停。

items.sentenceEn: The hikers crossed rocky terrain.
items.sentenceZh: 徒步者穿过岩石地形。
items.scene: Broad rocky mountain landscape with uneven ridges, exposed stone and a winding safe walking route; two small hikers give scale. Terrain itself is focal, no extreme climbing or writing.
items.altText: 崎岖岩石山地中，徒步者沿安全路径行走。

items.sentenceEn: She felt annoyed when the tap kept dripping.
items.sentenceZh: 水龙头不停滴水让她感到烦恼。
items.scene: Adult woman near a dripping kitchen tap shows a restrained annoyed expression, knitted brows and pressed lips; she reaches for repair tools to resolve it. Complete face, no yelling or symbols.
items.altText: 女子因厨房水龙头不停滴水而皱眉，准备修理。

items.sentenceEn: The buzzing fly was annoying.
items.sentenceZh: 嗡嗡叫的苍蝇很烦人。
items.scene: A small fly repeatedly circles a person trying to enjoy a quiet meal; subtle flight trail around ear, person gently waves it away with mild irritation. Fly and nuisance central, no insect injury or text.
items.altText: 苍蝇在用餐者耳边盘旋，惹得他轻轻挥手驱赶。

items.sentenceEn: Crossing the broken bridge would be risky.
items.sentenceZh: 穿过破损的桥会有风险。
items.scene: Hiker stops on solid ground before a clearly damaged footbridge with missing planks over a ravine, wisely turns toward a safe alternate path. Visible hazard, no one stepping onto bridge or falling.
items.altText: 徒步者停在缺失木板的桥前，转向安全路线。

items.sentenceEn: The app showed the bus route.
items.sentenceZh: 应用程序显示了公交路线。
items.scene: Clearly stylized clay-like hand holds a phone showing a text-free app screen with a simple route line, bus icon and map blocks; actual bus approaches in background. Illustrated materials, no photographic rendering, logos or readable UI.
items.altText: 手机应用以地图路线和公交图标显示公交线路。

items.meaningZh: 意大利面食；糊剂；泥膏剂
items.sentenceEn: He served pasta with tomato sauce.
items.sentenceZh: 他端上了配番茄酱的意大利面。
items.scene: Hand-painted still life of a shallow ceramic bowl of recognizable pasta with red tomato sauce and basil, beside fresh tomatoes and a plain fork. Broad brush strokes and paper texture, no photo or labels.
items.altText: 陶碗里盛着配番茄酱与罗勒的意大利面。

items.sentenceEn: The students used laboratory apparatus to filter water.
items.sentenceZh: 学生们用实验室仪器过滤水。
items.scene: Chinese school science laboratory, adult students use a clearly supported funnel with filter paper over a conical flask and beaker of cloudy water; transparent water drips into flask. No flame, hazardous chemicals, labels or digits.
items.altText: 实验室里，学生用漏斗、滤纸与锥形瓶过滤水。

items.sentenceEn: The library grouped books by genre.
items.sentenceZh: 图书馆按体裁将书籍分组。
items.scene: Three clearly separated library shelf sections with text-free illustrated book covers: detective mystery clues, distant-space science-fiction worlds, and gentle romance scenes. Each section consistent within itself, covers show pictures only. No readable titles, labels or logos.
items.altText: 图书按侦探、科幻与爱情等体裁分组摆放，封面只有图画。

items.sentenceEn: The shop sells comfortable everyday apparel.
items.sentenceZh: 这家店出售舒适的日常服装。
items.scene: Chinese neighborhood clothing shop, neat rack of everyday shirts, trousers and jackets with tactile fabric textures; shopkeeper helps a customer feel soft fabric. No mannequins, brands, tags or written signage.
items.altText: 社区服装店陈列日常衣物，店员与顾客查看柔软面料。

items.sentenceEn: A sudden noise can distract the student.
items.sentenceZh: 突然的噪声会让学生分心。
items.scene: Two-panel sequence of adult student studying plant drawings at desk; sudden clatter of a fallen metal pan from adjacent kitchen makes student turn away from book toward noise. No sound letters or words, clear loss of focus.
items.altText: 学生原本专心看书，厨房落锅声使他转头分心。

items.sentenceEn: The shaded courtyard looked appealing on a hot day.
items.sentenceZh: 炎热天气里，阴凉的院子显得很有吸引力。
items.scene: Chinese courtyard on hot summer day: warm sunlit street contrasts with inviting shaded seating under a leafy tree, tea and a cool breeze; a passerby smiles and moves toward welcoming shade. No signs or text.
items.altText: 炎热街道旁，树荫下的院子与座位吸引路人前来休息。

items.meaningZh: 优点；功绩；价值；功过；真相
items.sentenceEn: The design had the merit of saving water.
items.sentenceZh: 这个设计的优点是节水。
items.scene: Paired garden irrigation comparison using equal planted beds: old sprinkler wastes water outside bed, improved drip irrigation delivers water only to roots with a visibly smaller reservoir depletion. Focus on beneficial property of design, no medals, digits or text.
items.altText: 滴灌将水送到根部，与浪费水的喷灌形成对比，体现节水优点。

items.sentenceEn: The walk gave her a healthy appetite.
items.sentenceZh: 散步后，她食欲很好。
items.scene: After walking in a Chinese riverside park, adult woman at a nearby home table looks eagerly at a balanced meal of rice, vegetables and soup, reaching calmly for chopsticks; walking shoes near doorway give context. No exaggerated eating, weight stereotypes or text.
items.altText: 散步归来，女子精神饱满，期待享用米饭、蔬菜和汤。
